PropertyList.text: ============================================================= Panzer IV - Weapon System ============================================================= Keys: e = Cannon fire (30s reload) g = Machine gun (hold) y = AA MG 34 q / w = Turret left / right (hold = continuous) x = Turret center r / f = Barrel up / down (hold = continuous) c = Barrel center ============================================================= rudder = Turn left/right trottle = Acceleration M = Reverse m = Forward =============================================================
